podcast.title: The Planning Desk
podcast.description: Fifteen minutes of supply chain planning and design news every Sunday, with a focus on the Nordics and the DACH region: disruptions, trade and macro signals, planning technology and AI, real company use cases and the events worth your time. Made in partnership with Optilon.
podcast.ai_disclosure: The Planning Desk is produced with AI. AI agents gather and summarise the week's news from public sources, and the hosts' voices are synthetic.
podcast.author: The Planning Desk

jingles.intro_prompt: Up-tempo rock intro for a news podcast, 10 seconds, instrumental, around 150 BPM. Driving overdriven electric guitar riff, punchy live drums with a big snare, tight bass. Energetic and confident, builds fast and hits a clean final power chord on the last beat.
jingles.outro_prompt: Up-tempo rock outro for a news podcast, 10 seconds, instrumental, around 150 BPM, same band sound as the intro: overdriven electric guitar riff, punchy drums, tight bass. Ends on a big final power chord with a cymbal crash and a short natural decay.
